findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "lead-intelligence" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: lead-list-cleaner · Private data: pricing_info, domain-to-verified-work-email, job-posting-to-hiring-manager-email · Public sink: domain-to-verified-work-email, job-posting-to-hiring-manager-email · Destructive: lead-list-cleaner.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: lead-list-cleaner · Private data: pricing_info, domain-to-verified-work-email, job-posting-to-hiring-manager-email · Public sink: domain-to-verified-work-email, job-posting-to-hiring-manager-email · Destructive: lead-list-cleaner

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
